CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE LAB_DB.DW.SP_LOAD_DIM_STORE("BATCH_ID" VARCHAR)
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS $$
MERGE INTO DW.DIM_STORE tgt
USING (
  SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.city,
    s.state_code,
    s.country_code,
    r.region_name,
    s.open_date,
    s.close_date,
    s.store_type,
    s.square_footage
  FROM STAGING.RAW_STORES s
  LEFT JOIN DW.LKP_REGION r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
) src
ON tgt.store_id = src.store_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  tgt.store_name = src.store_name,
  tgt.city = src.city,
  tgt.state_code = src.state_code,
  tgt.country_code = src.country_code,
  tgt.region_name = src.region_name,
  tgt.close_date = src.close_date,
  tgt.store_type = src.store_type,
  tgt.square_footage = src.square_footage,
  tgt.etl_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  store_id, store_name, city, state_code, country_code,
  region_name, open_date, close_date, store_type,
  square_footage, etl_created_at
) VALUES (
  src.store_id, src.store_name, src.city, src.state_code,
  src.country_code, src.region_name, src.open_date,
  src.close_date, src.store_type, src.square_footage,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
);
$$;

name: SP_LOAD_DIM_DATE
ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE LAB_DB.DW.SP_LOAD_DIM_DATE()
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS $$
INSERT INTO DW.DIM_DATE (day_date, year_num, quarter_num, month_num, week_num, day_of_week, is_weekend, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
SELECT
  d.day_date,
  YEAR(d.day_date),
  QUARTER(d.day_date),
  MONTH(d.day_date),
  WEEKOFYEAR(d.day_date),
  DAYOFWEEK(d.day_date),
  CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.day_date) IN (0, 6) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END,
  CASE WHEN MONTH(d.day_date) >= 7 THEN YEAR(d.day_date) + 1 ELSE YEAR(d.day_date) END,
  CASE WHEN MONTH(d.day_date) >= 7 THEN QUARTER(d.day_date) - 2 ELSE QUARTER(d.day_date) + 2 END
FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(DAY, SEQ4(), '2020-01-01')::DATE AS day_date
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 3650))
) d
WHERE d.day_date NOT IN (SELECT day_date FROM DW.DIM_DATE);
$$;

name: SP_LOAD_FACT_SALES
ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE LAB_DB.DW.SP_LOAD_FACT_SALES("BATCH_ID" VARCHAR)
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS $$
INSERT INTO DW.FACT_SALES (
  sale_id, store_id, product_id, date_key, quantity,
  unit_price, discount_pct, net_amount, tax_amount,
  total_amount, etl_batch_id, etl_created_at
)
SELECT
  s.transaction_id,
  d_store.store_id,
  d_prod.product_id,
  d_date.date_key,
  s.quantity,
  s.unit_price,
  COALESCE(s.discount_pct, 0),
  s.quantity * s.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(s.discount_pct, 0) / 100),
  s.tax_amount,
  s.quantity * s.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(s.discount_pct, 0) / 100) + s.tax_amount,
  :batch_id,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
FROM STAGING.RAW_TRANSACTIONS s
JOIN DW.DIM_STORE d_store ON s.store_code = d_store.store_id
JOIN DW.DIM_PRODUCT d_prod ON s.sku = d_prod.sku
JOIN DW.DIM_DATE d_date ON s.sale_date = d_date.day_date
WHERE s.transaction_id NOT IN (SELECT sale_id FROM DW.FACT_SALES);
$$;

name: SP_LOAD_FACT_INVENTORY
ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE LAB_DB.DW.SP_LOAD_FACT_INVENTORY("BATCH_ID" VARCHAR)
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS $$
TRUNCATE TABLE DW.FACT_INVENTORY;
INSERT INTO DW.FACT_INVENTORY (
  snapshot_date, store_id, product_id, quantity_on_hand,
  quantity_on_order, reorder_point, days_of_supply, etl_batch_id
)
SELECT
  i.snapshot_date,
  i.store_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.qty_on_hand,
  i.qty_on_order,
  i.reorder_point,
  CASE WHEN avg_daily.avg_qty > 0
    THEN i.qty_on_hand / avg_daily.avg_qty
    ELSE 999
  END AS days_of_supply,
  :batch_id
FROM STAGING.RAW_INVENTORY i
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT product_id, store_id, AVG(quantity) AS avg_qty
  FROM DW.FACT_SALES
  WHERE date_key >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_DATE())
  GROUP BY product_id, store_id
) avg_daily ON i.product_id = avg_daily.product_id AND i.store_id = avg_daily.store_id;
$$;

name: SP_REFRESH_AGGREGATES
ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE LAB_DB.DW.SP_REFRESH_AGGREGATES()
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS $$
TRUNCATE TABLE DW.AGG_DAILY_SALES;
INSERT INTO DW.AGG_DAILY_SALES (day_date, store_id, total_sales, total_qty, avg_ticket)
SELECT
  d.day_date,
  f.store_id,
  SUM(f.total_amount),
  SUM(f.quantity),
  AVG(f.total_amount)
FROM DW.FACT_SALES f
JOIN DW.DIM_DATE d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.day_date, f.store_id;

CALL DW.SP_LOG_ETL_STATUS('AGG_DAILY_SALES refreshed');
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE LAB_DB.DW.SP_CURRENCY_CONVERT("TARGET_CURRENCY" VARCHAR)
RETURNS STRING
LANGUAGE SQL
EXECUTE AS CALLER
AS $$
UPDATE DW.FACT_SALES f
SET f.total_amount_usd = f.total_amount * r.exchange_rate,
    f.currency_code = :target_currency
FROM DW.LKP_EXCHANGE_RATES r
WHERE f.currency_code = r.source_currency
  AND r.target_currency = :target_currency
  AND f.date_key BETWEEN r.effective_from AND r.effective_to;
$$;

name: V_SALES_BY_STORE
ddl:
CREATE VIEW LAB_DB.DW.V_SALES_BY_STORE AS
SELECT
  s.store_id,
  st.store_name,
  st.city,
  st.country_code,
  d.year_num,
  d.month_num,
  SUM(s.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(s.quantity) AS total_units,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.sale_id) AS transaction_count,
  AVG(s.total_amount) AS avg_ticket_size
FROM DW.FACT_SALES s
JOIN DW.DIM_STORE st ON s.store_id = st.store_id
JOIN DW.DIM_DATE d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY s.store_id, st.store_name, st.city, st.country_code, d.year_num, d.month_num;

name: V_PRODUCT_PERFORMANCE
ddl:
CREATE VIEW LAB_DB.DW.V_PRODUCT_PERFORMANCE AS
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.brand,
  p.category_name,
  SUM(f.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units,
  SUM(f.total_amount) - SUM(f.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS gross_margin
FROM DW.FACT_SALES f
JOIN DW.DIM_PRODUCT p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category_name;

name: V_TOP_SELLERS
ddl:
CREATE VIEW LAB_DB.DW.V_TOP_SELLERS AS
WITH ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.brand,
    p.category_name,
    SUM(f.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_name ORDER BY SUM(f.total_amount) DESC) AS rank_in_category
  FROM DW.FACT_SALES f
  JOIN DW.DIM_PRODUCT p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN DW.DIM_DATE d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.day_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, CURRENT_DATE())
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category_name
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_products
WHERE rank_in_category <= 10;

name: V_INVENTORY_HEALTH
ddl:
CREATE VIEW LAB_DB.DW.V_INVENTORY_HEALTH AS
SELECT
  i.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  i.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  i.quantity_on_hand,
  i.reorder_point,
  i.days_of_supply,
  CASE
    WHEN i.quantity_on_hand <= 0 THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK'
    WHEN i.quantity_on_hand < i.reorder_point THEN 'LOW_STOCK'
    WHEN i.days_of_supply > 90 THEN 'OVERSTOCK'
    ELSE 'HEALTHY'
  END AS stock_status
FROM DW.FACT_INVENTORY i
JOIN DW.DIM_STORE s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN DW.DIM_PRODUCT p ON i.product_id = p.product_id;

name: V_RETURN_ANALYSIS
ddl:
CREATE VIEW LAB_DB.DW.V_RETURN_ANALYSIS AS
WITH return_rates AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS return_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_id) AS sale_count,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds
  FROM DW.FACT_SALES f
  LEFT JOIN DW.FACT_RETURNS r ON f.sale_id = r.sale_id
  JOIN DW.DIM_PRODUCT p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_name
)
SELECT
  *,
  ROUND(return_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(sale_count, 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM return_rates;

name: MV_MONTHLY_REVENUE
ddl:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LAB_DB.DW.MV_MONTHLY_REVENUE AS
SELECT
  d.year_num,
  d.month_num,
  SUM(f.total_amount) AS monthly_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_id) AS transaction_count
FROM DW.FACT_SALES f
JOIN DW.DIM_DATE d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.year_num, d.month_num;
